༄༅/ /tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi skong ba 'chi med 'dod 'jo'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi skong ba 'chi med 'dod 'jo'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

hrīḥ lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i zhing*// klong yangs 'khyil ba'i gzhal med khang*// ye shes lnga yi rang 'od 'bar// bde chen padmo bkod pa nas// tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med// rang snang sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs bcas// gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir dgongs mdzod// gzung 'dzin ro mnyam ngang du bzhugs// yid dpyod bral bar phyag bgyi 'o// dug lnga gnas dag ye shes kyi// 'od zer lnga yi rang mdangs las// rang byung rang shar mchod pa'i sprin// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri zhal rol mo dbyangs// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// mdzes pa'i lha mo bcu drug dang*// sman gtor rakta tshogs mchod sogs// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid// dwangs ma bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog las// rang grub skong rdzas nam mkha' mdzod// chos dbyings gdod nas khyab pa yis// thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// hrīḥ dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur// chos kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang*// nam mkha'i rgyal po gangs chen mtsho// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang*// rang byung sangs rgyas padma skyes// sprul pa'i sku yi thugs dam bskang*// skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i sku /ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang*// 'chi bdag bdud bcom 'od kyi lus// ting 'dzin bzang po'i thugs dam bskang*// 'byung bzhir dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro'i gtso// 'ja' tshon snying po'i thugs dam bskang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku /chos dbyings rdo rje'i thugs= mkhyen brtse nus ldan gsang ba'i bdag /grags pa mchog dbyangs thugs= bi ma dngos byon 'gro ba'i skyabs// bzang po rdo rje'i thugs= mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan// padma legs grub thugs=

brtul zhugs spyod 'chang he ru ka /nam mkha' 'jigs med thugs= brgyud pa'i bka' babs 'gro ba 'dul// bstan pa dar rgyas thugs= gsar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me mchog /karma chags med thugs= sbyang pa sngon song bka' srol 'dzin// lung zin chos bdag thugs= bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs// 'chi med dngos grub kun 'dus kyi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// 'du shes rnam dag bcom ldan 'das// snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med// na bza' dkar mo yum dang 'khril// dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs dam bskang// nam mkha'i khams kyi bcud sdus la// sems kyi khams kyi tshe nyams gsos// dran bya dran byed snyigs ma sbyongs// dag pa ye shes rang rtsal rgyas// gsung mchog rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// rnam shes rnam dag bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med// sangs rgyas spyan ma yum dang 'khril// shar gyi tshe bdag thugs dam bskang*// sa yi khams kyi bcud sdus la// sha yi khams nas tshe nyams gsos// sa khams sha yi snyigs ma sbyongs// sa bcud sha yi dwangs ma skyed// thugs mchog rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// tshor ba rnam dag bcom ldan 'das// rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med// yum chen mā ma kī dang 'khril// lho yi tshe bdag thugs dam bskang// chu yi khams kyi bcud sdus la/ khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams gsos// chu khams khrag gi snyigs ma sbyongs// chu bcud khrag gi dwangs ma skyed// yon tan rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// gzugs phung rnam dag bcom ldan 'das// rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med// yum chen dbyings phyug ma dang 'khril// nub kyi tshe bdag thugs dam bskang*// me yi khams kyi tshe nyams gsos// drod kyi khams nas bcud sdus la// me khams drod kyi snyigs ma sbyongs// me bcud drod kyi dwangs ma skyed// sku mchog rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// 'du byed rnam dag bcom ldan 'das// don yod grub pa tshe dpag med// dam tshig sgrol ma yum dang 'khril// byang gi tshe bdag thugs dam bskang*// rlung gi khams kyi bcud sdus la// dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams gsos// rlung khams dbugs kyi snyigs ma sbyongs// rlung bcud dbugs kyi dwangs ma skyed// phrin las rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// 'jam dpal gzhon nu spyan ras gzigs// gsang ba'i bdag po padma 'byung*// rgyal kun rdo rje bzhi yi dngos// 'gro 'dul sku bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// mchog gsum rtsa gsum rig pa 'dzin// drang srong tshe la dbang rnams kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs mngon shes tshe'i// dngos grub bsdus nas bdag la stims// dam tshig sdom nyams sor chud nas// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// puṣpe dkar mo dhū pe ser// ā lo dmar mo gandhe ljang*// las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub mdzad ma// mgyogs ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// brgya byin 'jog po 'khor los sgyur// lha klu mi dbang tshe bsod can// stobs rtsal che ba'i srog chags dang*// mkha' lding zil dang ldan sogs kyi// tshe bsod kha rje dbang thang dang*// snyan grags klung rta'i dwangs ma sdus// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol// rnam par rgyal ba gshin rje'i gshed// rta mgrin dbang chen bdud rtsi 'khyil// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo srung yab yum thugs dam bskang*// gdon bgegs sde brgyad 'byung po yis// bla tshe srog dbugs phrogs pa dang*// brkus dang bcom pa rang gnas khug

/'thor dang zhig pa shul du chugs// tshe bdud bar chad rdul du rlogs// gzhan yang tshe lha rig 'dzin dang*// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gtsang rigs dpal mgon la sogs pa// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bla tshe srog tshe nyams pa gsos// gas pa sbyor la yar ba khug /chad pa mthud la yo ba srongs// tshe dbang 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod// phyi snod 'jig rten rab 'byams kyi// 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma lus la stims// nang bcud khams gsum srid gsum gyi// skye 'gro'i shes rgyud ngag la stims// gsang rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// thugs rje byin rlabs sems la stims// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// hrīḥ rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs dgongs// thams cad chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid// gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa la// ma rtogs gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i dbang*// skye 'chi 'khor ba lu gu rgyud// bar med ngang du sgrib bsags pa// las nyon spyi dang khyad par du// sdom pa gsum gyi chag nyams dang*// srog bcad rten gsum gzhig gzhom dang*// rdeg rdung rku 'phrog la sogs pa// tshe thung nad mang dbang thang gud// bar gcod mang ba'i las sgrib rnams// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags// tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol// snang sems zung 'jug ngang du bshags// rig stong klong du sor chud shog /thams cad rdo rje tshe lha yi// dkyil 'khor mtha' dbus med par dag /a 'thas 'khrul pa'i ming yang med// lhun grub rin chen gsang ba'i sbubs// gzhon nu bum pa skur smin nas// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur med pa yi// 'ja' lus rdo rje dwangs ma'i sku /tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med// mngon gyur don gnyis lhun grub shog / de skad rdo rje'i tshig gi gser phreng la// so skye'i tshig rgyan ra gan mi mdzes kyang*// gsol bskang smon lam mos blos byas pa la// nyes med phyir na 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skabs// rten 'brel ched du su kha badzra yis// kun bzang bde chen gling bris yi ge pa// rang slob karma 'gyur med tshe dbang ngo*// nyes mchis rtsa gsum chos skyong srung mar bshags// dge bas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes shog
